hooks.command: if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then RUFF=.venv/bin/ruff; else RUFF=.venv/Scripts/ruff; fi; out=$("$RUFF" check . 2>&1); rc1=$?; out2=$("$RUFF" format --check . 2>&1); rc2=$?; if [ $((rc1 | rc2)) -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg r "Ruff gefaald - fix dit eerst:\n${out}\n${out2}" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":$r}}'; fi
